Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 13

“Just as the embodied self passes through childhood, youth, and old age in this body, so it passes into another body. The steady are not deluded by this.”

The analogy is deliberately homely. Arjuna already accepts that he survived the death of his own childhood; Krishna simply extends a change he has lived through into one he fears.
